summary: Recent updates in the Canvas testing area of Firefox bring several improvements that enhance performance and security for graphics rendering. One notable change is the **introduction of WebGL Vendor and Renderer protection in Nightly Picture-in-Picture Mode (PBM)**, which helps safeguard users by ensuring that potentially sensitive graphics information is not exposed to web pages. Additionally, on Apple Silicon devices, the browser will no longer request a discrete GPU for OpenGL rendering, which can lead to better resource management and improved battery performance. These adjustments reflect a continuous effort to optimize graphical experiences while prioritizing user privacy.
